notes.title: Team Ladybug's First Original Metroidvania: New Blade Chimera Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear all,

There's only a month left until the release of Blade Chimera, Team Ladybug's very first original Metroidvania, on January 16, 2025!

You might already know Team Ladybug's well acclaimed ability to develop original games from playing DRAINUS. Blade Chimera now has a new demo, so please try it out to see what their original Metroidvania feels like!

Back in June, we made a demo for Steam Next Fest, and in the past half year that demo has been further improved and expanded on to make this new demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/c12eb0a55ee8ce4f28f9fc6b465f698e777e08fe.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Stage 2: Phoenix Gardens is now playable
[*]Added a new ability to Lux, the Demon Sword: When you’re separated from the Demon Sword, power is charged in the blade. When it returns to you, it creates a shockwave that deals damage along its path
[*]Added a new collectable item: Puzzle Pieces
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/83f454527ba0ef8b530cf4cad2d914fb511c9e4a.gif[/img]

Some parts of the demo might even remind you a little of DRAINUS...
We hope you like the new demo. 
lease wishlist the game and look forward to launch!

notes.title: Ver1.0.6.1 Update - 10 New Additional Languages
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your continued support for DRAINUS.
We're excited to announce full support for 10 additional languages, so now you get to enjoy the game in your preferred language!

Additional Languages:
French / Italian / German / Spanish - Latin America / Thai / Turkish / Portuguese - Brazil / Traditional Chinese / Korean / Russian

We hope you continue to enjoy DRAINUS!

notes.title: Update Ver 1.0.2.8
notes.content:
Thank you all for your continuous support for DRAINUS.
Please find the full list of changes below:

Fixes/Changes:
[b]Arcade Mode[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421467/7116fb5a253d506b445fccef6467227e93bccb21.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Addition of 3 new modes (Normal, Hard, Extended Modes)
[*]Added time display for enemies with score time limits
[*]Users can now pause game by holding down the pause button even after using the "Pause/Toggle Equipment" function in-game
Users can now also choose to end the game in that state
[/list]

[b]All Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Perfect Guard no longer reduces while Reflector is activated
[*]Shortened the time it takes to bring up the "Pause/Toggle Equipment" screen
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where swapping the upper and lower weapons causes both weapons to become the same weapon
[*]Fixed issue where upper and lower weapons cannot be swapped around in between stages (during warp zone)
[*]Fixed issue where swapping equipment to Ultra Beam immediately after using Hurricane Bomb causes both attacks to activate
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy DRAINUS!
